environment: Miniflare D1 with explicitly configured Better Auth test credentials

cases.title: Unsigned bearer values no longer select an account
cases.actual: Anonymous response; arbitrary test-user bearer rejected

cases.title: Stale cloud writes preserve the winning revision
reproduction: Create a D1-backed project at revision 1
Send two PUT requests with expectedRevision=1
cases.expected: One write succeeds; the other receives 409 and cannot overwrite the winner
cases.actual: One 200 and one 409; latest project and exactly one revision 2 snapshot remain

cases.title: Project save and revision snapshot commit atomically
reproduction: Install a temporary trigger that rejects revision inserts
PUT a new project name and revision
cases.expected: 503 with the prior project and revision intact
cases.actual: 503; project remains at its original name and revision 1

cases.title: Missing auth configuration fails closed
reproduction: Call /api/auth/get-session without D1, secret, HTTPS base URL, and GitHub OAuth credentials
cases.expected: 503 AuthenticationUnavailable; no fallback identity or credentials

cases.title: Session credentials are not serialized in profile responses
reproduction: Read /api/me using a valid D1 Better Auth session
cases.expected: Profile and reduced session metadata without token fields
cases.actual: Session token and token property absent

cases.title: OAuth callback does not implicitly link a different GitHub identity by email
reproduction: Complete a mocked GitHub callback for a new identity
Start another callback with the same verified email and a different provider account ID
cases.expected: First identity creates one account; second is rejected without another account or session
cases.actual: First sign-in succeeds; second redirects with account_not_linked; one user record remains

cases.title: Hosted OAuth and cloud bindings are not verified in the review Site
reproduction: Inspect current Sites adapter configuration and run local D1 auth tests
cases.expected: Live GitHub credentials and D1 binding available for deployed sign-in/cloud verification
cases.actual: Local D1 behavior passes; deployed D1 and OAuth are not provisioned or exercised
cases.test: No hosted credential or binding test is available in this environment

verification.fullTestRun: passed on isolated rerun; initial run overlapped typecheck and ended with one worker RPC timeout
verification.githubOAuthExchange: mocked; no external credential or request
